items.title: Darnell Howard Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: Did you play with Cap? Heck yes. Where? At the Deluxe.

ctx.x: Sure. Did you play with Cap? Heck yes. Where? At the Deluxe. Oh you did? Sure did. How was he as a trumpet player? Marvelous. Marvelous. Sweet tone and a hell of a lip. Oh yeah? Yes. It's too bad he didn't make any records to my big thing. He had a complex about his records. Somebody wanted to make records they think he wanted to steal his stuff. Yeah. Have you heard that? Yes. Sure. I remember that. It's true. You know one of his sweet numbers was Orly and Rose. I mean he really played it. And then the band…
Ranked himself to death. Was he very heavy, fast by the time you saw him?
